alignments.note: The predicate the second colon gaps is realized again by the pro-verb 'do', which joins this verb's one discontinuous unit headed on the first occurrence (rules 34 and 25).
The ASV writes 'becometh not a fool' with a bare object, leaving the preposition nothing (rule 40).
Supplied indefinite article joins the noun (rule 15).
Nomen rectum rendered attributively as 'Excellent' (rule 28). The margin's 'Arrogant' was read and set aside (rule 38).

The particle pair 'aph ki is rendered by the single compound expression 'Much less', of which neither morpheme owns a part (rule 30); source head is the governing first particle (rule 23) and target head the content word 'less' (rule 24). Competing reading splits 'Much' from 'less'.
The ASV writes 'a prince' bare, spending no word on this preposition's relation (rule 40).
Supplied indefinite article joins the noun (rule 15).

review_notes: The supplied 'do' of the second colon is the pro-verb answering the gapped predicate the Hebrew wrote once, under rule 34, rather than an added auxiliary.
'aph ki is taken as one fused rendering 'Much less'; the split reading is named in the unit's note.
